# webview_completion_fix

Source: https://github.com/linxunfeng/flutter_webview_completion_fix/blob/main/README.md

# webview_completion_fix


A Flutter plugin that fixes iOS WebView crashes caused by uncalled completion handlers in WKWebView navigation delegate methods.

Related issue: [flutter/flutter#102476](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/102476)

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_webview_completion_fix/blob/main/README-zh.md)

## ☕ Support me


Chat: [Join WeChat group](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/JBbMstn0qW6M71hh-BRKzw)

## ✨ Features

✅ **Zero Configuration**: Works out of the box - just add the dependency  
✅ **Non-Intrusive**: Uses method swizzling without modifying your existing code  
✅ **Safe Defaults**: Invokes missed completion handlers with sensible default values  
✅ **Optional Logging**: Enable detailed logging for debugging purposes  

## 📦 Installation

Add this to your package's `pubspec.yaml` file:

```yaml
dependencies:
  webview_completion_fix: latest_version
```

Then run:

```bash
flutter pub get
```

Installation complete! No additional configuration needed. Now you can enjoy using it 🥳

## 🔍 Troubleshooting

To help diagnose issues, you can enable detailed logging by adding the following to your iOS app's `Info.plist`:

```xml
<key>WCFEnableLogging</key>
<true/>
```

Location: `ios/Runner/Info.plist`

With logging enabled, you'll see detailed console output:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_assets/main/flutter_webview_completion_fix/1.png)
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_assets/main/flutter_webview_completion_fix/2.png)

If you're still seeing crashes related to completion handlers after installing this plugin, please:

1. Verify the plugin is properly initialized by checking the console logs (with `WCFEnableLogging` enabled)
2. Report the issue with detailed logs to our [issue tracker](https://github.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_webview_completion_fix/issues)

# webview_completion_fix

Source: https://github.com/linxunfeng/flutter_webview_completion_fix/blob/main/README-zh.md

# webview_completion_fix


一个修复 iOS 因 WKWebView 导航代理方法中 completion handler 未被调用而导致的崩溃问题的 Flutter 插件。

相关 issue: [flutter/flutter#102476](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/102476)

[English](https://github.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_webview_completion_fix/blob/main/README.md) | 简体中文

## ☕ 请我喝一杯咖啡


微信技术交流群请看: [【微信群说明】](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/JBbMstn0qW6M71hh-BRKzw)

## ✨ 特性

✅ **零配置**：开箱即用 - 只需添加依赖即可  
✅ **无侵入性**：使用方法交换技术，无需修改现有代码  
✅ **安全默认值**：使用合理的默认值调用遗漏的 completion handlers  
✅ **可选日志**：支持启用详细日志以便调试  

## 📦 安装

在你的 `pubspec.yaml` 文件中添加以下依赖：

```yaml
dependencies:
  webview_completion_fix: latest_version
```

然后运行：

```bash
flutter pub get
```

安装即可，无需配置，现在可以愉快的玩耍了 🥳

## 🔍 故障排除

为了帮助诊断问题，你可以通过在 iOS 应用的 `Info.plist` 中添加以下配置来启用详细日志：

```xml
<key>WCFEnableLogging</key>
<true/>
```

文件位置：`ios/Runner/Info.plist`

启用日志后，你将在控制台看到以下详细输出

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_assets/main/flutter_webview_completion_fix/1.png)
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_assets/main/flutter_webview_completion_fix/2.png)

如果安装此插件后仍然看到与 completion handlers 相关的崩溃，请：

1. 通过检查控制台日志（启用 `WCFEnableLogging`）验证插件是否正确初始化
2. 向我们的 [issue tracker](https://github.com/LinXunFeng/flutter_webview_completion_fix/issues) 报告问题并附上详细日志
